title: Three Birds in Desert
description: Three large birds stand in a row on yellow sand. A black bird covered in white marks is on the left, a brown bird is in the middle, and a white bird is on the right, with a pale sun in the sky above.
prompt: A painting of three large birds standing together on yellow desert sand. On the left is a tall black bird with white marks on its feathers and long tail. In the middle is a brown bird with yellow beak. On the right is a white bird with fluffy feathers. A large pale sun hangs in the light gray sky above them. The ground has small stones and footprints.
